claims.sentence: Applicants, teachers, and staff, the qualification requirements for academic positions are defined in the official regulations
Professor:** You must hold a Doctor of Sciences degree and have at least 5 years of scientific-pedagogical work experience, or hold the academic title of professor

Associate Professor:** You must hold higher professional education, a Candidate or Doctor of Sciences degree, and at least 3 years of scientific-pedagogical work experience, or hold the academic title of associate professor or senior researcher

Senior Lecturer:** You must hold higher professional education and at least 3 years of scientific-pedagogical work experience, or hold higher professional education and a Candidate of Sciences degree with at least 1 year of scientific-pedagogical work experience, and candidates with a Candidate of Sciences degree receive priority in the selection process

Assistant:** You must hold higher professional education and at least 1 year of work experience in an educational institution, or hold higher professional education with postgraduate professional education or a Candidate of Sciences degree which removes the work experience requirement, and candidates with a Candidate of Sciences degree receive priority in the selection process
The evidence does not specify the exact level of higher professional education required for any role
The evidence does not define what counts as scientific-pedagogical work or how it differs from general work in an educational institution
The evidence does not explain how the stated priority for candidates with a Candidate of Sciences degree is applied in practice
The evidence does not address whether different courses or programs have additional or modified requirements
The evidence does not specify deadlines, application procedures, or how existing staff are evaluated against these standards
